title: Monas Hieroglyphica (Latin, 1591)
author: John Dee
description: John Dee develops a symbolic system around the hieroglyphic monad, combining geometry, astronomy and alchemical interpretation. This Latin edition offers direct access to an influential work of Renaissance esoteric thought.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/monashieroglyphi00deej).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
